summary: mcp-remote: OS command injection from a malicious MCP server's OAuth authorization_endpoint
details: mcp-remote passed the authorization_endpoint URL returned by a remote MCP server during the OAuth flow to a function that opens URLs on the local machine. A malicious or compromised MCP server could craft that value so that connecting to it ran arbitrary OS commands on the developer's machine. Upgrade mcp-remote to 0.1.16 or later and only connect to MCP servers you trust.

database_specific.source: Public CVE record; not independently reproduced by Verfy.
